_doc: Playable locations: the game's selection of real places. NOT a list of Angola's provinces or administrative units (those are in admin.json). Each location keeps its real type and points to the administrative unit it belongs to; 'existence' and 'admin_link' are verified separately and an inferred or unverified link must stay labelled as such until a source confirms it. Maps are in maps.json; gameplay attributes in attributes.json.
